purpose: Définir une signature corporelle stable par personnage afin que posture, déplacement, gestes et réactions découlent de l'intention et non d'une pantomime émotionnelle générique.

darius.eye_contact: direct_but_not_continuous; breaks only to assess environment or conceal attachment
darius.equipment_behavior: shield creates personal boundary and protective axis

states.fear: reduce gesture count; scan exits; shield closer to body
states.anger: less movement rather than more; consonant physical stops; jaw and grip carry tension
states.hope: chest opens slightly; eye contact held a fraction longer
states.fatigue: weight sinks through hips; shield lowers between threats but rises early
states.injury: protect wound without theatrical clutching; movement path becomes more direct
states.altered_perception: stillness increases first; gaze tests impossible spaces before body follows

aurelien.eye_contact: alternates between person and evidence; returns to listener on conclusion
aurelien.walk: tracks details and changes line when something catches attention
aurelien.stop: head or eyes stop before feet when noticing a clue
aurelien.sit: leans toward object or speaker when thinking
aurelien.hands: small explanatory shapes; fingers become still when truly alarmed
aurelien.equipment_behavior: tools and objects become anchors for thought, never fidget props

states.fear: search behavior narrows; hands stop illustrating ideas
states.hope: body leans into possibility before words confirm it
states.fatigue: slower visual scanning; shoulders carry cognitive load
states.injury: protective adaptation remains practical, not performative
states.altered_perception: eyes lock on pattern; body lags behind realization

malvor.eye_contact: brief_precise; looks away when care becomes too visible
malvor.walk: short efficient routes; avoids center unless claiming space
malvor.hands: tension hides in fingers, straps and equipment checks
malvor.equipment_behavior: maintenance gestures reveal concern more often than touch

states.fear: checks routes and gear instead of pacing
states.anger: movements become cleaner and more exact
states.fatigue: more weight through one side; fewer corrections
states.injury: compensates silently until function is affected
states.altered_perception: tests reality with object contact and distance

lysandra.eye_contact: responsive; releases pressure deliberately when calming others
lysandra.walk: continuous curved approaches that preserve others' space
lysandra.stop: decelerates rather than snaps unless shocked
lysandra.sit: shares orientation with listener rather than squaring up
lysandra.hands: open gestures, but hands settle completely when offering certainty
lysandra.equipment_behavior: keeps hands available for care or signaling

states.fear: flow tightens; breath becomes visible before gesture changes
states.anger: curved approach becomes direct and still
states.hope: upper body opens; movement gains gentle forward continuity
states.injury: breath pattern reveals pain before posture does
states.altered_perception: listens to empty space with unnerving calm, then reorients to people

hungry_ghoul.walk: low uneven crawl_walk with long arm reach
hungry_ghoul.hands: claws read hunger, threat and escape path

states.fear: body angle turns toward exit before feet move
states.anger: distance closes abruptly without display roar requirement
states.injury: protects damaged side while keeping escape available
states.capture_window: retreat becomes readable; avoids eye line; threat remains present

ash_witness.eye_contact: incidental; repetition matters more than target fixation
ash_witness.hands: one recurring gesture is the visual teaching tool

states.recognition_window: repetition pauses long enough for player comprehension
states.stagger: pattern breaks visibly rather than simply flinching
states.defeat: ritual axis collapses before body falls
